title: Theo and the Protocol
author: Kestrel Vane
blurb: Yara Almeida, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
